anchors.1: clearly broken or fails the brief
anchors.3: usable but visibly generic, inconsistent, or under-polished
anchors.5: production-ready, coherent, deliberate, and strongly satisfies the brief

dimensions.label: Brief adherence
dimensions.description: Does the result actually satisfy the requested content, states and constraints?

dimensions.label: Composition / hierarchy
dimensions.description: Is attention directed correctly and is the layout balanced and intentional?

dimensions.label: Visual polish
dimensions.description: Do shapes, assets, spacing and styling feel production-ready rather than placeholder-like?

dimensions.label: Motion quality / easing
dimensions.description: Does motion have coherent timing, easing, anticipation/settle where appropriate, and avoid robotic or excessive movement?

dimensions.label: Readability / clarity
dimensions.description: Can users understand the primary information or interaction state quickly?

dimensions.label: Coherence / restraint
dimensions.description: Do visual and motion choices form one system without unnecessary decoration or conflicting direction?

dimensions.label: Technical correctness
dimensions.description: Does the Rive behave/render correctly without obvious broken states, clipping, missing assets or invalid interaction behavior?

binary.label: Would you ship this without manual visual correction?

instructions: Do not inspect blind-map.keep-hidden.json before scoring.
Score preview and filmstrip together when both exist.
Judge against the brief, not against assumptions about which implementation produced the artifact.
Record scores independently before comparing paired outputs.
